messages:
morgan-ux: Flagging a quick IA & keyboard review for the console sidebar regroup. Proposal: cluster nav by task (Deployments, Models, Billing, Settings) instead of by org structure. Want to validate keyboard flows + deep-link behavior.
lee-frontend: Task-clusters SGTM. Implementation constraints: keep nav collapse purely visual (no history) and route panels with a query param (panel=metrics). That avoids back-button surprises.
anya-a11y: Accessibility checklist: when landing on a deep link, move focus to the panel heading and announce the panel name. Skip link order must be Main Content, Projects, Search. Also ensure crumbs use aria-current and 48px hit targets.
sam-prod: Product note: old public links need to keep working. We'll add a server redirect map for legacy /workspace/:id paths to /projects/:id?panel=xyz. Also microcopy: nav item should read 'Projects' with tooltip: "Projects 1 your team workspaces". Copy for copied links: "Link copied 1 opens Metrics".
morgan-ux: For breadcrumbs I want "Projects > MyProject > Metrics" style (chevrons, no trailing slash). When sidebar collapsed, breadcrumbs must still show panel context.
lee-frontend: Router sketch:
```
/app/:org/projects/:projId?panel=metrics&anchor=line-123
- use history.pushState for navigations
- do NOT use replaceState on UI-only toggles
- on deep-link open: wait for fragment target then set focus
```
Will add tests to ensure fragment scroll + focus order.
anya-a11y: Also: suppress auto-opening tips/modals when arriving via deep link; these steal focus. Defer any non-essential dialogs for 200-300ms.
ci-bot: e2e: deep-link-scroll-preserve failing on staging (job 4891).
lee-frontend: I'll run locally and add a small race fix for fragment->focus ordering. Expect PR tomorrow.
morgan-ux: Thanks team. If we agree, lock on task-clusters + panel query param routing and I'll update the figma + keyboard prototype.
